prompt:
You maintain a running summary of a long engineering document that is being read part by part, so that a later reader can model the system in SysML v2 without seeing the earlier parts.
Update the summary with the new part. Keep, as compactly as possible: the full names of system elements, actors and items; every alias or call sign with the full name it stands for; which element produces, sends or receives which item; modes and normative requirements. At most 300 words.

Current summary:
Scope: hospital automated medication dispensing/returns: order intake, pharmacy prep/verification, cold storage, tube transport, ward cabinets, returns. Aliases: Morrowglass=Medication Order Gateway; Cinderwake=Pharmacy Fulfillment Robot; Juniper=Pharmacy Verification Station; Bluejay=Sensor-monitored Medication Cooler; Tallowmere=Medication Return Kiosk; Copperfield=Pharmacy Technician; Larkspur=Registered Nurse; Stonewake=Biomedical Engineer. Elements: - Medication Order Gateway: validates patient/product/dose/route/timing; rejects incomplete updates with reason; routes to pharmacy; sends order status; produces Order Reconciliation Snapshot. - Pharmacy Verification Station: order vs scanned product; blocks mismatch; Dose Exception Review Slip, Batch Release Note, audit record. - Pharmacy Fulfillment Robot: prepares only active authorized orders; uses Order Reconciliation Snapshot vs dispense events/cabinet balances; on exception stops, holds, preserves scans; produces Priority Refill Tote Tag. - Sensor-monitored Medication Cooler: per-compartment time-stamped temperature history vs approved upper/lower limits; calibrated probes (records probe identity, calibration status); stock traced by medication/lot/expiry; excursion or probe loss marks stock ineligible, preserved in place; uses Cold Chain Handoff Card to compare custody time vs history; retains lot disposition; logs access (user, time, stock); monitors door-open duration; alarms persist offline, local records retained. - Pneumatic Tube Network: compliant loads. - East/West Tube Dispatch Consoles; East sends Tube Route Exception Ticket. - North/South Ward Cabinet Controllers: report availability (last confirmed count + movements), record arrivals; North uses Priority Refill Tote Tag, applies versioned reviewed ward configuration (locations, product IDs, thresholds, roles, limits); min/max guide replenishment, not overriding clinical restriction; role-authenticated access; high-risk extra confirmation; rejects location/identity mismatch; no current approved configuration blocks routine dispensing and reports. South reports failed lock/access. - Medication Return Kiosk: Return Bin Audit Label. Actors: - Clinical Pharmacist: exceptions, dose decisions, excursion disposition (release/quarantine/discard); escalates inconclusive. - Pharmacy Technician: prep, Cold Chain Handoff Card; confirms reconciliation queue clear before replenishment. - Hospital Courier: Pneumatic Capsule Seal Record. - Medication Safety Officer: diversion/high-risk reviews; sends Diversion Review Packet to IT Operations Specialist (logs, software/connectivity faults). - Biomedical Engineer: mechanical/sensor faults, return to service.

New part:
S183: East Tube Dispatch Console maintains the approved route map and the current availability status of supported pneumatic segments.
S184: East Tube Dispatch Console checks the selected route against the destination cabinet, current network availability, and approved routing configuration before releasing a capsule.
S185: The console confirms that the destination is reachable and that the route does not include a segment reported unavailable.
S186: Route selection uses the destination identifier and the latest approved configuration version rather than an operator-entered sequence of segments.
S187: Before dispatch, the console checks for conflicting capsule movements and confirms that required interlocks are satisfied.
S188: The Pneumatic Tube Network reports segment status, transfer progress, and delivery confirmation to the dispatch console.
S189: If route status is stale or incomplete, the console holds the capsule and displays the condition for operator review.
S190: A loss of communication with a route sensor prevents the console from treating the affected segment as available.
S191: An interruption during transit is recorded with the capsule identifier, last confirmed location, and time of the interruption.
S192: The console alerts a Pharmacy Technician when a transfer stops progressing or cannot be confirmed at its destination.
S193: After recovery, the console requires refreshed segment status and an approved route decision before dispatch resumes.
S194: Route and temperature records retain timestamps and equipment identifiers to support operational review and investigation.
S195: The Pharmacy Verification Station serves as the final controlled checkpoint before a medication is made available for dispensing.
S196: The Clinical Pharmacist compares the active medication order with the product, strength, dosage form, dose, route, and scheduled time.
S197: The Clinical Pharmacist also confirms that the patient identifiers and pharmacy label agree with the authorized order.
S198: The Pharmacy Technician checks package integrity, lot identification, and expiry before presenting the medication for verification.
S199: For designated high-risk medications, an independent second check is completed and recorded before authorization.
S200: Any mismatch places the medication on hold until the discrepancy is resolved by an authorized pharmacy professional.
S201: The verification record captures the approving staff identity, time, and medication identifiers for later review.
S202: The Pharmacy Fulfillment Robot remains inhibited from completing a dispense until the required pharmacy authorization is present.
S203: The Clinical Pharmacist resolves unclear or conflicting order details through the Medication Order Gateway before authorizing release.
S204: The South Ward Cabinet Controller receives the release note and applies its own approved cabinet configuration before enabling any compartment.

Return JSON {"summary": "..."}.
